login.subtitle: AI-Powered Healthcare Management System
login.insightSpo2: SpO2 at 92% is below safe level
login.insightBp: BP has been high in last 2 visits
login.errorApiUrlProd: Missing API URL: in Vercel → Settings → Environment Variables, set VITE_API_URL to your backend (e.g. https://xxx.up.railway.app), then redeploy.
login.errorApiUrlDev: Missing VITE_API_URL in frontend/.env (e.g. VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:5000). Restart the dev server after changing it.
login.errorFirebaseProd: Firebase is not configured ({{list}}). In the Vercel project → Settings → Environment Variables, add every value from Firebase Console → Project settings → Your apps (Web). Redeploy after saving — Vite bakes these in at build time.
login.errorFirebaseDev: Firebase is not configured ({{list}}). Copy frontend/.env.example to frontend/.env, paste your Firebase web app config, then restart the dev server (npm run dev).
login.errorRoleUnknown: Your account role is not recognized. Contact admin.
login.auth_user_not_found: No account found for this email.
login.auth_too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Try again later.
login.auth_network_request_failed: Cannot reach Firebase (network or blocked request). Confirm all VITE_FIREBASE_* env vars match Firebase Console, redeploy after changing them, disable VPN/ad-block for this site, and ensure Email/Password sign-in is enabled in Firebase Authentication.
login.errorAccount404: Your account is not registered in the system. Contact admin@careops.com.
login.error401: Could not verify your session with the server. Try again.
login.errorNetwork: Cannot reach the CareOps API. Set VITE_API_URL on Vercel to your Railway URL and redeploy.

pharmacy.noPending: All caught up. No pending prescriptions.

pharmacy.phoneMissing: Not on file — open card; patient must save mobile in Profile

doctor.title: Doctor Dashboard
doctor.subtitle: Live patient queue and consultation management
doctor.selectPatient: Select a patient to view their case
doctor.selectHint: Choose someone from the live queue
doctor.generateSoapHint: After you stop recording, tap Generate SOAP Note so Gemini documents the visit, extracts medicines, and runs the safety check. (Manual step avoids running AI on half-finished notes.)
doctor.soapMustFill: SOAP sections must be filled (run Generate SOAP Note after your notes are complete).
doctor.addMedsHint: Add medicines in the transcript and generate SOAP again, or ensure the Plan section lists medications.
doctor.aiFlaggedHint: AI flagged a prescription concern — fix the plan or medicines, then generate SOAP again. Approve stays off until the check passes.
doctor.confirmLocked: Confirm and Send to Pharmacy — locked
doctor.confirmHint: There is no separate Confirm button. This turns green after SOAP is filled, medicines are listed, and the AI check passes.
doctor.selectForInsights: Select a patient to view insights
doctor.possibleMedIssue: Possible issue with medicines vs diagnosis / symptoms
doctor.aiCrosscheckOk: AI cross-checked listed medicines against the SOAP note — no conflict flagged. You can approve when ready.
doctor.speechDenied: Microphone blocked. Allow microphone access for this site in your browser settings, then try Start Recording again.
doctor.speechHttps: Voice input needs a secure (HTTPS) page or localhost in most browsers.
doctor.loadCaseError: Failed to load patient case. Please try again.
doctor.panelInsightFailed: Failed to generate insights. Click Retry.
doctor.soapGenerateFailed: Failed to generate SOAP note. Please try again.
doctor.confirmPrereq: Complete Generate SOAP Note with medicines (or plan text) and a passing AI check before sending.
doctor.errorSessionExpired: Session expired — sign out and sign in again.
doctor.errorApiUnreachable: Cannot reach API. Set VITE_API_URL to your Railway URL (Vercel) or run the backend locally.
doctor.errorConfirmFailed: Failed to confirm. Please try again.
